statement.zh: Jacobsen & Lloyd《杰尔万的辛那赫里布渡槽》OIP 24（1935）报告 1933 年发掘的石砌渡槽及戈梅尔渠首相关工作。
statement.en: Jacobsen & Lloyd Sennacherib’s Aqueduct at Jerwan (OIP 24, 1935) reports the 1933 excavation of the stone aqueduct and related Gomel canal-head work.

editorial.notes: Paraphrased from cited registered sources only.
